component.name: Album Builder
component.summary: Curate an album from a folder of songs

description.p: Album Builder helps you put an album together from a folder of songs. Pick the tracks you want, drag them into order, listen through with the lyrics scrolling along, and when you are happy, approve it.
Approving makes a ready-to-share album folder: a playlist, the tracks numbered in order, and a printable report.

screenshot.caption: The song library, the album's track order, and the song now playing
The Player tab with its own music library

description.p: You can undo removing a song from an album with Ctrl+Z. Album reports print on white paper, keep their bold title, and the tick column for adding songs sits next to the play button.
